summary: Get the minutes and date created for all parent topics
description: Returns an array of objects of minutes and created_on values for all parent meeting topics

schema.description: Minutes recorded on each ancestor (parent) of the requested topic, ordered from nearest parent outward.

id.description: Identifier of the ancestor meeting topic these minutes belong to.

meeting_id.description: Identifier of the Meeting the ancestor topic belongs to.

created_on.description: Date the ancestor topic's minutes were recorded.

minutes.description: Rich-text (HTML) minutes recorded on the ancestor topic, or a placeholder message when none exist.

no_minutes.description: True when the ancestor topic has no recorded minutes.

marked.description: Whether the ancestor topic's minutes are starred (flagged for emphasis on the PDF).

meeting_position.description: Position of the ancestor topic's Meeting within its series.

403.description: User does not have the right permissions to view the meeting
